visualRisks.description: The route path crosses over several houses, which could obstruct the view or create a visual clutter.
The color of the road (#667b8a) and ground (#283e35) are very similar, which might make it hard to distinguish between them.

navigationRisks.description: The route is quite complex with many turns and backtracking, which could be confusing for players trying to follow it.
There are potential dead ends in the route that could trap players or make navigation difficult.
